Server-enforced rename, reparent, duplicate, and archive/delete for world nodes without orphaning descendants, maps, or saga references — no UI redesign.

- #714 domain hierarchy and #715 create RPC on main
- Self-host DB for optional smoke; migration additive

## Happy Path

- [x] Domain helpers validate reparent edges, cycles, and rename status transitions
- [x] `rename_world_node` keeps id/seed_key; placeholder→draft; never auto-canonical
- [x] `reparent_world_node` rejects bad edges/cycles/cross-world; updates primary map parent; marks unlocated

## Edge Cases

- [x] Reparent into own descendant blocked
- [x] Archive keeps UUIDs and saga FKs; delete refuses without confirm when bindings exist
- [x] Unauthorized / missing JWT rejected
